traps.description: train/test split that shares timepoints or uses future timepoints to predict earlier ones = temporal leakage

traps.description: strain 'truth' from the SAME metagenomic caller (or a correlated one) is circular ground truth

traps.description: per-sample depth is very low + sparse; strain signal collapses below coverage threshold

traps.description: must compare to a strain-caller (e.g. StrainPhlAn/inStrain) AND a naive single-strain / BAF-threshold baseline
